message:
feat(layout): three source roots rust/ js/ ts/ (plan 16 L1, issue #1138)

Move the crate under rust/ (src, tests, examples, Cargo.toml, build.rs),
promote the old src/web tree to js/ as the second source root (worker
mirror under js/worker/), and add ts/ as a generated-tree placeholder,
with docs/source-roots.md documenting the roots and their editors.

- The worker entry js/worker/formal_ai_worker.js resolves importScripts
  and fetch against the web root, so the module list, seed inventory and
  wasm fetch stay web-root relative wherever the entry sits; the app
  boots it as worker/formal_ai_worker.js and the bundle carries the same
  one-string change. The module list generator, the Node mirror harness
  and the meta-algorithm worker-source reader all exclude the entry,
  which loads the list rather than belonging to it.
- The census namespace stays crate-relative (src/...): build.rs strips
  the manifest prefix, so data/meta/self-ast document paths and census
  constants are unchanged. Specification suites resolve crate-namespace
  paths (src/, tests/, examples/) against the crate root through a
  shared tree_path helper, so seed recipes keep their crate-relative
  vocabulary; repo trees (data/, docs/, js/, experiments/) still resolve
  from the repository root.
- Ledgers, allowlists, requirement-status rows and issue-1138 shards
  carry rust/-prefixed tree paths; the core-boundary ledger adds the
  calendar_create and policy_gates rows (count 51 -> 53) with both line
  ceilings and eleven baselines re-measured, and the debt ratchet
  records the corrected undercount 46 -> 48.
- Test needles follow the documents they quote: living docs (README,
  REQUIREMENTS, meta-algorithm and testing guides) now state
  --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml commands, while frozen case studies
  keep their pre-move tree vocabulary and their needles with them.
  Meta-recipe spec suites resolve their seed_file/test_file existence
  checks through tree_path, and recipe-asserted literals stay
  crate-relative (reasoning_standard, meta_self_improvement,
  obligation ledger).
- CI keeps working after the move: workflow path filters, green-ledger
  path lists, agent-cli-e2e example-script invocations and the
  self-ast census trigger filters all carry rust/-prefixed crate paths;
  the hello-world contract generator and its hive-mind test point at
  rust/examples/hello-world, and detect-code-changes keeps excluding
  the examples tree in its new location.
- Cargo's CWD-relative data/ cache default now writes under rust/ when
  cargo test runs; that scratch tree is gitignored like its root twin.
- Registered web-stage gates keep working from the new layout: the e2e
  checker scripts resolve the repo root one hop deeper, the language
  gates carry rust/-prefixed crate paths and skip pure renames (a move
  changes no line), the vscode/desktop resource and server-candidate
  resolvers point at js/ and rust/Cargo.toml, and the issue-513
  vocabulary sync reads the js/ seed mirror. The disk-usage,
  cache-budget and capability-routing gate scripts read the crate at
  its new path (manifest, reference roots, planner/frontier sources,
  example runner).
- Gate test rust/tests/unit/issue_1138_three_source_roots.rs registered
  in the same commit with its merge-conflict-policy and .gitattributes
  mirror entries (lockstep trio). The measured merge-conflict ledger keeps
  its historical paths (history did not change); policy deferrals match
  the measured forms and moved artifact entries carry extracted_from with
  their old paths so retired append points stay covered. The worker line
  budget gains the entry-file shard now that it lives in js/worker/.
- Regression mirrors: issue_1069 solve_issue_request reads the work item
  before project lookup (web_fetch first, per #904 and 0bc8d42e2), and
  the offline-leg discriminator in solver_unknown_reasoning.rs is
  restored verbatim.
